articles.summary: 5 Must-Have Foods to add to your Diet! Like Superman, some foods are life savers. Superfoods are generally plant-based dietary items that have an exceptional density of nutrients and provide a variety of health advantages. Cabbage or Karam Sang (a.k.a. Kale), broccoli, avocados, and spinach, for example, are some such
